# CRE8

> CRE8 is the home of productive portfolios: baskets of tokenized US stocks (bStock) and crypto that you buy with USDT, with yield on idle capital. Portfolios are held in an on-chain account only you control. CRE8 is currently on testnet; test USDT is free.

## What you can do
- Buy a ready-made portfolio with one payment, starting from 50 USDT.
- People portfolios follow public disclosures: Pelosi Portfolio (stock trades Nancy Pelosi's household discloses to Congress), Trump Holdings (Office of Government Ethics disclosures), Musk Basket, Duan Yongping (US stocks in his public filings).
- Theme portfolios include AI Chips, AI Memory, Korea Semis, Mag7, Bitcoin Plus, BNB Ecosystem, US Market and 3x leveraged baskets.
- Build your own basket: pick up to 10 stocks or crypto assets, set weights, choose a rebalancing schedule (daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly), and CRE8 keeps it on target.

## Key facts
- Payment: USDT.
- Custody: self-custody; shares sit in an on-chain account only the user controls.
- Status: testnet (not real money yet).
- Availability: anyone outside the US, where local rules allow.
